spanish: Y vio Faraón que hubo alivio, y hizo pesado su corazón, y no oyó a ellos, como que habló Jehová.

findings.issue: כַּאֲשֶׁר is preposition + relative (as / according as). 'como que' in current Latin American Spanish hedges (as if / sort of) or turns causal, which that token does not license.
הָיְתָה הָרְוָחָה is 'the relief was' (definite noun). 'hubo alivio' is an indefinite existential and does not show the article.

notes: Faraón, Jehová, hiphil hizo pesado su corazón, and no oyó a ellos match the tokens.
